editorial:
Imagine being a huge comic book nerd who just wants to fit in, only to end up as a science experiment gone wrong. You get swept up in a story about a shy guy who gets injected with a weird serum that slowly turns him into a giant spider. It feels like a B-movie from the old days but with a modern twist. While he is losing his humanity and craving bugs, a local cop starts finding bodies wrapped in sticky webs. The vibe is a mix of gross-out horror and a sad story about a guy who just can't control his new instincts.

The special effects are a bit dated, but that actually adds to the charm if you love campy monster flicks. The acting is solid enough to keep you interested, and the pacing moves quickly so you never get bored. If you enjoy movies where humans turn into creatures, you will have a blast with this one. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you like owning discs, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends. It is a great pick for a rainy Saturday.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the spider-man completely loses his mind and goes on a killing spree. The cop finally tracks him down to his lair. In a final showdown, the monster is defeated and killed, putting an end to the web-covered murders. It wraps up as a cautionary tale about science and loneliness, leaving you feeling bad for the guy even though he became a scary monster.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school creature features and B-movies.
